name: hunt-plan-ash-1
label: Ash composes the plan from its own map and proposes it: its plan node links the deer, its spot, its role, each member

name: hunt-plan-ash-2
label: On the way to its spot, the plan is held in mind (rehearsed) and predicts where the others will be

name: hunt-plan-bryn-1
label: Bryn hears the plan, grounds the places in its own landmarks, and builds a plan node of its own: it joins

name: hunt-plan-bryn-2
label: On the way to its spot, the plan is held in mind (rehearsed) and predicts where the others will be

name: hunt-plan-dee-1
label: Dee hears the plan, grounds the places in its own landmarks, and builds a plan node of its own: it joins

name: hunt-plan-dee-2
label: On the way to its spot, the plan is held in mind (rehearsed) and predicts where the others will be

name: hunt-plan-cai-declines-1
label: Cai hears the plan; it feels cool towards Ash and trusts it little, so the plan feels bad to it: it declines out loud

name: hunt-breach-1
label: Waiting by the rock: the plan predicts the deer grazing at its meadow

name: hunt-breach-2
label: The deer is not where the plan said: a prediction error; 'a broken plan' and danger light up; Ash whistles at once

name: hunt-breach-3
label: After the breach: arousal up, the plan's hold shaken; the drivers set off on the whistle

name: hunt-betray-cai-1
label: Cai hears the plan against Dee. It feels more for Dee than for Ash: it says 'I'm in', and forms an intent of its own, to tell Dee

name: hunt-betray-cai-2
label: Out of the others' sight, Cai whispers the plan to Dee

name: hunt-betray-dee-1
label: Dee is warned: their plan becomes predictions of its own (who waits where), and it proposes a counter-plan to Cai, in a whisper

name: hunt-betray-dee-2
label: Dee and Cai set off for a spot behind the ones lying in wait

name: hunt-betray-ash-1
label: Ash waits hidden by the windmill, predicting Dee on its way and Cai at its post

name: hunt-betray-ash-2
label: The breach: someone is not where the plan said: surprise, a broken plan, danger

name: hunt-betray-ash-3
label: The ambush turned into a fight; afterwards Ash weighs who could have told
